newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol says no improvement in chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Repsol says no improvement in chemicals.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol said on Tuesday that results from all of its activities had improved in the first nine months of the year except from chemicals.
In a statement on nine-month earnings, Repsol said, "All areas of activities improved their results in this period except chemicals, which was affected by an international narrowing of margins."
Repsol reported a decline of 5.6 percent in nine-month net earnings, worse than a decline of 3.6 percent on average expected by analysts surveyed by Reuters.

"Results were also influenced by the weak stage of the business cycle in Europe and the carrying out of large investments that are key to the company, but which, in certain cases, won't pay off for several years," it said.

Repsol said other factors affecting results were the recovery of international refining margins, the favourable evolution of crude prices, and the peseta's foreign exchange rate, which depreciated slightly against the dollar but climbed against the mark.
